label: 暗處凝視

request.prompt: Low bass clarinet in its dark chalumeau register sustains narrow semitone movement over a quiet cello pedal, thin muted viola harmonics answer in the distance. Suffocating acoustic chamber horror, steady slow harmonic breathing, no jazzy rhythm, no whimsical woodwind flourishes, no lilting tune. Pure instrumental psychological horror chamber score for a dark fantasy visual novel. At night a spider-like intruder silently searches a wooden inn while an unknowing woman walks into danger. Cold invasive dread, claustrophobic suspense, an unseen predator already inside, oppressive unresolved tension. The same music must sustain a companion's persistent foreboding after a forest battle, on the return to the inn. Clearly musical pitched instruments, dark sustained harmonic friction and restrained continuous musical motion. Stay intimate and ominous throughout, maintain presence for all 25 seconds, no ending cadence or empty silence. No cheerful, playful, bouncy or romantic melody, no sentimental lament, no heroic action, no fast battle percussion. No vocals, speech, choir, wind, rain, insects, footsteps, creaks, static, environmental ambience or sound effects.
